hero_eyebrow: Female Plumbing Engineers — Leicester & Surrounding Areas

services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From emergency repairs and boiler servicing to full bathroom installations, E & J cover every plumbing and heating need in and around Leicester.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, sudden leaks, or loss of water pressure — we respond quickly to protect your home from further damage. Same-day callouts available across Leicester.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Regular boiler servicing keeps your heating running efficiently and safely throughout the year. We diagnose faults fast and carry out lasting repairs you can rely on.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Whether you need a new central heating system or want to upgrade an ageing setup, we install high-efficiency systems tailored to your home's requirements.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: From full bathroom fit-outs to replacing a single fixture, our team handles all plumbing aspects of your bathroom project with a clean, professional finish.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Cold spots, noisy radiators, or a brand-new radiator needed in a newly decorated room — we install and repair radiators quickly and with minimal disruption.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can cause serious structural damage if left untreated. We locate and repair leaks efficiently, saving you money on water bills and costly remedial work.

about_pullquote: We believe every customer deserves a plumber they genuinely feel safe welcoming in.
about_para_1: E & J Female Plumbing & Heating was founded right here in Leicester with a clear purpose: to provide a professional, high-quality plumbing and heating service delivered by female engineers. We understand that inviting a tradesperson into your home should feel comfortable and safe, and we've built our entire business around that principle.
about_para_2: Our reputation across Leicester has grown through honest work, transparent pricing, and a genuine commitment to getting every job done properly first time. Customers return to us again and again because they know they'll receive the same reliable, respectful service every single visit.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About E & J

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service from start to finish. As a woman living alone I always feel awkward having tradespeople in the house, but E & J made me feel completely at ease. The repair was done quickly, the price was fair, and they left everywhere spotless. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: Called E & J after a pipe burst on a Sunday morning and they were with me within a couple of hours. Really professional, explained everything clearly, and sorted it out without any fuss. Will definitely be using them again for my boiler service.
reviews.author: Priya S.

reviews.text: Had a new bathroom fitted and E & J handled all the plumbing side of things. Turned up on time every day, kept the mess to a minimum, and the finished result is fantastic. Great value too — I got three quotes and theirs was the most competitive by far.
reviews.author: Rachel B.
